description: Flat record-level metadata schema for experiments differentiating induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) derived from skin fibroblasts into cardiomyocytes, capturing provenance, reprogramming, culture conditions, genetic modifications, and differentiation/function outcomes.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record or experimental sample/condition.

experiment_id.descr: Identifier linking related records from the same experiment, study, or batch.

sample_id.descr: Identifier for the iPSC line, differentiation replicate, or analyzed sample.

donor_id.descr: Identifier for the original skin fibroblast donor, if applicable and de-identified.

species.descr: Species of donor/cell line; commonly 'Homo sapiens' for human iPSCs.

tissue_source.descr: Original somatic tissue used to derive iPSCs; expected value: skin fibroblast.

reprogramming_method.descr: Method used to generate iPSCs from fibroblasts, e.g., Yamanaka factor reprogramming.

yamanaka_factors.descr: List or textual description of reprogramming factors used, e.g., OCT4, SOX2, KLF4, c-MYC.

reprogramming_delivery_method.descr: Delivery system for reprogramming factors, e.g., lentiviral, episomal, Sendai virus, mRNA.

reprogramming_efficiency_percent.descr: Percentage of starting fibroblasts that yielded iPSC colonies; units: percent (%).

genetic_background.descr: Relevant donor genetic background or ancestry information, as recorded; use standardized terminology when possible.

sex.descr: Biological sex of the donor, if known; e.g., female, male, unknown.

age_years.descr: Donor age at biopsy/reprogramming in years, if known.

disease_status.descr: Disease state of the donor, if relevant; e.g., healthy, cardiomyopathy, control.

patient_genotype.descr: Known genotype or pathogenic variant(s) relevant to the donor/cell line, if available.

cell_line_name.descr: Standard or laboratory name of the iPSC line.

passage_number.descr: Passage number of the iPSC culture at the time of differentiation or assay.

culture_medium.descr: Basal medium used for maintenance or differentiation, including key formulation if needed.

media_composition.descr: Detailed composition of the culture medium, including supplements, cytokines, small molecules, and concentrations when available.

substrate_coating.descr: Surface coating or substrate used for cell culture, e.g., Matrigel, vitronectin, gelatin, fibronectin.

extracellular_matrix_source.descr: Source or product information for the extracellular matrix/substrate, if relevant.

seeding_density_cells_per_cm2.descr: Initial plating or seeding density; units: cells per square centimeter.

confluency_percent.descr: Estimated cell confluency at key differentiation initiation or assay time point; units: percent (%).

oxygen_tension_percent.descr: Oxygen concentration during culture or differentiation; units: percent (%).

co2_percent.descr: CO2 concentration in incubator; units: percent (%).

differentiation_protocol_name.descr: Name or identifier of the cardiomyocyte differentiation protocol used.

differentiation_protocol_version.descr: Version or revision of the differentiation protocol.

differentiation_start_date.descr: Date when cardiomyocyte differentiation was initiated.

differentiation_duration_days.descr: Total duration of differentiation before harvesting or assay; units: days.

induction_cues.descr: Chemical, growth factor, or signaling pathway manipulations used to induce cardiomyocyte differentiation, e.g., Wnt activation/inhibition.

genetic_modification_introduced.descr: Whether any genetic modification was introduced to enhance differentiation; true/false.

genetic_modification_type.descr: Type of genetic modification, e.g., knockout, knock-in, transgene, CRISPR edit, overexpression.

genetic_modification_target.descr: Target gene(s), locus, or construct used in the genetic modification.

genetic_modification_method.descr: Method used to introduce the genetic modification, e.g., CRISPR-Cas9, TALEN, viral transduction.

epigenetic_perturbation.descr: Any epigenetic editing or treatment applied to influence differentiation, e.g., DNMT inhibitor, HDAC inhibitor.

qc_karyotype_status.descr: Karyotype quality status at the time of use; e.g., normal, abnormal, not assessed.

qc_mycoplasma_status.descr: Mycoplasma contamination status; e.g., negative, positive, not tested.

qc_pluripotency_marker_status.descr: Summary status of pluripotency marker validation; e.g., positive, partial, negative.

differentiation_efficiency_percent.descr: Fraction of cells that acquired cardiomyocyte identity or marker positivity; units: percent (%).

cardiomyocyte_purity_percent.descr: Proportion of cardiomyocytes in the final population; units: percent (%).

cardiomyocyte_marker_expression.descr: Measured expression of cardiomyocyte markers such as TNNT2, ACTN2, MYH6, MYH7; report as text or standardized panel summary.

beating_observed.descr: Whether spontaneous contractile beating was observed in the differentiated culture; true/false.

time_to_beating_days.descr: Number of days from differentiation start to first observed beating, if applicable.

electrophysiology_assay_type.descr: Assay used to assess cardiomyocyte electrophysiology, e.g., patch clamp, MEA, calcium imaging.

action_potential_duration_ms.descr: Measured action potential duration, if assessed; units: milliseconds (ms).

calcium_transient_amplitude.descr: Quantitative measure of calcium transient response, if assessed; use assay-specific normalized units if needed.

contractility_measurement.descr: Quantitative contractility metric, if measured; include units in accompanying text if necessary.

functional_maturation_score.descr: Composite or assay-defined score indicating cardiomyocyte functional maturation; higher values should indicate greater maturation.

genomic_marker_signature.descr: Genetic marker panel or variant signature associated with successful differentiation, if measured.

epigenetic_marker_signature.descr: Epigenetic marker panel associated with differentiation outcome, if measured; e.g., DNA methylation, histone modification profile.

transcriptomic_marker_signature.descr: Transcriptomic marker panel or expression signature associated with differentiation outcome, if measured.

assay_date.descr: Date on which the main differentiation outcome assay was performed.

operator_id.descr: Identifier for the person or system performing the experiment or assay.

batch_id.descr: Batch identifier to capture technical batch effects across culture runs or assay dates.

replicate_number.descr: Technical or biological replicate number for this record.

qc_pass.descr: Whether the record passed predefined quality-control criteria for downstream analysis; true/false.

notes.descr: Free-text comments on deviations, anomalies, or additional context relevant to interpretation.
